title: Disappointing
text: Disappointing. I’m at fault for not reading entirely the size of this music box. It’s a little larger than a match box. I won’t hold Amazon accountable for my failure. This music box will easily fit in a pocket but the structure of the music box would probably be destroyed. I’m very disappointed.
